name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 11 – Am 56
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 11e. Expresses its deep concern over the fact that the Commission has funded or co-financed campaigns promoting the wearing of the veil, asserting, for example, that ‘freedom is in the hijab’; emphasises that the Union’s budget must no longer finance future campaigns that directly or indirectly promote the wearing of the veil;
